features.title: Built for players and site owners

upload.title: Upload and share
upload.body: Upload skins and capes, keep them public or private, and collect others' work in your closet.

players.title: Many players, one account
players.body: Manage several in-game players from one account; each has its own skin and keeps its UUID when renamed.

launcher.title: Works with launchers
launcher.body: Compatible with authlib-injector, CustomSkinLoader and friends; migrated sites need no client changes.

selfhost.title: Self-host in minutes
selfhost.body: Unzip and run on Windows, macOS or Linux, or deploy with Docker and Kubernetes. Plugins, themes and settings reload live.

launcher.title: Use it in your launcher
launcher.body: In a launcher that supports authlib-injector, add an external authentication server with this address:
launcher.note: External login opens in an upcoming release; the address will stay the same.

skinlib.title: Skin Library
skinlib.body: The skin library is under construction and arrives in the next milestone (M2).

about.title: About SkinLoom
about.intro: SkinLoom (云织) is an open-source, self-hosted Minecraft skin site with a Go backend and a Next.js frontend, released under the MIT license.
about.thanksIntro: SkinLoom stands on the shoulders of these open-source projects:
about.blessing: SkinLoom's design is inspired by and pays tribute to Blessing Skin. Some translations and rendering ideas come from Blessing Skin (MIT); its copyright notice is kept in the NOTICE file.
about.authlib: External authentication protocol and launcher injection
